tax.text: Feldman favors a simplified flat and sales tax system with minimal rates, a poverty-level rebate, and no other taxes.
tax.quote: A simpler system, with minimal rates and no deductions, would promote confidence by being more transparent.

wages.text: He says competition for workers and fewer federal regulations would raise wages.
wages.quote: Increasing the availability of jobs that creates competition for workers would help increase wages.

debt.text: He calls for spending cuts, debt reduction, and changes to Social Security and Medicare eligibility.
debt.quote: The government must spend less and pay down the debt.

housing.text: He says government regulations restrict needed housing construction and contribute to high prices.
housing.quote: Where we have a housing crisis, we should be asking to what extent our government regulations limit the housing construction needed to house people and bring down prices.

schools.text: He answered that he supports expanding charter schools, vouchers, homeschooling, and other school-choice options.
schools.quote:
Do you support expanding school choice options, including charter schools, vouchers, and homeschooling, to give parents and students more control over their education?
Support

safety.text: He strongly supports ending mandatory minimums for nonviolent offenses and emphasizing rehabilitation over incarceration.
safety.quote:
Do you support reforming the criminal justice system by ending mandatory minimum sentences for non-violent offenses and emphasizing rehabilitation over incarceration?
Strongly Support

immigration.text: He strongly supports making it easier for nonviolent immigrants to live and work legally without unnecessary restrictions.
immigration.quote:
Do you support policies that make it easier for non-violent immigrants to live and work in North Carolina legally, without unnecessary government restrictions?
Strongly Support

guns.text: Feldman supported opposing new state-level gun-control measures, although he did not support repealing all existing laws.
guns.quote: opposing any new state-level gun control measures? Support

abortion.text: He opposes forcing women to give birth in every circumstance while also saying fetal rights must be considered.
abortion.quote: I agree with the pro-Choice position that the government should not be in the business of forcing women to give birth, at all times, in all situations. I agree with the pro-Life position that the rights of the fetus must also be considered;

cannabis.text: He strongly supports decriminalizing cannabis and reducing penalties for nonviolent, victimless offenses.
cannabis.quote:
Do you support the decriminalization of cannabis and other measures that reduce penalties for non-violent, victimless crimes?
Strongly Support

health.text: He favors market-based health care, competition, high-deductible plans, and health savings accounts.
health.quote: My preference is to encourage market-based care. Markets give people incentives to choose lower cost options, create competition that would reduce health care prices, and give providers incentives to improve quality.

voting.text: He supports voter-ID requirements provided eligible voters can easily obtain identification.
voting.quote: Libertarians don’t care for government ID’s, but I personally believe that requiring a voter ID is entirely reasonable, if we make sure that all eligible voters are given or can easily obtain an ID.

wages.text: Bell said the minimum wage should rise with inflation.
wages.quote: I also think that increasing the minimum wage to keep up with inflation would also help that.

trade.text: Bell called the administration's tariffs unnecessary and said its decisions should be rolled back.
trade.quote: So the tariffs that were, you know, completely unnecessary and have damaged our relationships with other trade partners.

debt.text: Bell listed protecting Social Security among her affordability priorities.
debt.quote: Affordability: Lower drug and child care costs, expand housing supply, protect Social Security, support fair wages.

housing.text: Bell called for building more affordable housing and subsidizing qualifying builders.
housing.quote: More safe, affordable housing should be built, and builders who are willing to do so should receive subsidies if they meet requirements on timelines and quality.

schools.text: Bell says public schools should be fully funded and teachers should receive better pay.
schools.quote: Ashley wants public schools fully funded and teachers paid what they're worth.

immigration.text: Bell supports abolishing ICE, replacing it with a new enforcement agency and establishing a pathway to citizenship for law-abiding immigrants.
immigration.quote: Furthermore, a pathway to citizenship must be established for law-abiding, hardworking, tax paying immigrants who contribute to our society

guns.text: Bell supports what her campaign calls common-sense gun reform while also supporting the Second Amendment.
guns.quote: Common sense gun reform. Supporting the Second Amendment and opposing gun violence aren’t in conflict.

abortion.text: Bell's campaign published a proposed bill that would codify the right to choose.
abortion.quote: Returns the right to choose what happens to one's own body, and codifies this into law so it can never be stolen again.

health.text: Bell explicitly proposed a Medicare for All system.
health.quote: I would propose that we have a Medicare for all system.

energy.text: Bell supports the Green New Deal, clean-energy employment, pollution reduction, and expanded public transit.
energy.quote: Green New Deal. More clean energy jobs, less pollution, and expanded public transit.

trade.text: Harrigan signed a bipartisan letter urging federal action against solar imports that avoided existing U.S. duties.
trade.quote: This duty evasion and tax fraud is harming U.S. energy manufacturers and placing them at a clear competitive disadvantage,

schools.text: Harrigan calls for immediate school-choice options for parents while states reform public schools.
schools.quote: We must give parents school-choice options today while elected officials at the state level revamp our public school systems.

safety.text: Harrigan supports additional policy and investment to ensure police departments are adequately resourced.
safety.quote: And it is implemented by promoting policy and investment that adequately resources our police—not by defunding the police.
